core_obligations: Reduce to constant rank: the proof decomposes the space into disjoint open and closed subsets on which the two outer modules of the sequence have constant rank, so that the three determinants are ordinary exterior powers (proof lines 4709-4712)

Define the map: with the ranks r' and r'' fixed, the proof defines a map from the tensor product of the two exterior powers to the exterior power in degree r' + r'' by taking local sections to their wedge product after lifting the sections of the quotient (proof lines 4712-4729)
Verify: the author writes that the remaining details of the verification are omitted, the construction of the displayed map being the point of the proof (proof line 4730)

difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a canonical isomorphism from the tensor product of the determinants of the outer terms of a short exact sequence of finite locally free modules to the determinant of the middle term (author lemma at source lines 4694-4706, label lemma-det-ses). The proof (source lines 4708-4731) reduces to the case of constant ranks by splitting the space into open and closed pieces, then defines the comparison map on the tensor product of the two exterior powers by wedging local sections of the submodule with lifts of local sections of the quotient (proof lines 4712-4729). The construction of the map is the content; the author closes by stating that the details of the verification are omitted, and the card records that remark verbatim in the proof span. H2.
